# Electric Mobility Skill

> An Agent Skill for building EV charging software in any language: OCPI roaming (up to 2.3.0), OCPP 1.6, 2.0.1, and 2.1 with field-level message cards, CSMS, CPO, and eMSP architecture, tariffs, CDRs, smart charging, ISO 15118, supervision, driver apps, and deployment. Every task passes a risk-tiered security gate first. Plain Markdown, MIT license, by Codetics.

Start with SKILL.md, set the security tier, then load only the references its routing table names. Instructions for every assistant are in AGENTS.md.

## Entry points

- [SKILL.md](plugins/electric-mobility/skills/electric-mobility/SKILL.md): router, security gate, invariants, routing table, exit check
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how any AI agent should use the skill and edit this repository
- [README.md](README.md): what it covers, and how to install it for Claude, Codex, and other agents
